description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeSkillAPITest' that tests the 'EmployeeSkillAPI' class's API endpoints for employee skills in the OrangeHRM system. It includes tests for 'getOne', 'update', 'delete', 'create', 'getAll' methods, and validation rules, using mock objects and assertions.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSkillAPI, verifying functionality of API methods for CRUD operations and validation rules, using mock dependencies and assertions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeSkillService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a single employee skill by ID, including mocking DAO and service layers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee skill record via the API with mocked DAO and service layers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates rules for updating employee skills.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting employee skill records through the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies creation of a new employee skill record via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates rules for creating employee skills.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all employee skills with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates rules for fetching all employee skill records.
